notes.title: Update v1.16 - Small update for reported issue
notes.content:
-Fixed physics issue with the dead bodies in the Chainsaw Psycho boss area where projectiles (specifically rockets from the Rocket Launcher) would sometimes pass through the bodies and out of the map.

-Fixed issue with being able to open the main menu when transitioning through doors.

-Slightly increased pickup hitbox size for the Dynamite and Lockpick.

notes.title: Update v1.15 - Small bug fix for blank screen when launching the game.
notes.content:
[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Implemented possible fix for issue where after launching the game it would be stuck in a blank screen.

-Localization improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Update v1.14
notes.content:
[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Fixed bug in the Monstrous Beast Cave where stamina was still active even after clearing the area of all enemies.

-The selected inventory tab is now reset to "All Items" when starting a new game.

-The selected inventory tab is now saved and loaded.

-Localization improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Update v1.13
notes.content:
[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Updated Swedish language. Thank you, Simon Tessem (Gnydsmelt).

-Fixed issue with being able to go back to sleep after waking up in the apartment in Randomizer mode.

-Added option to disable the screen flash when taking damage. For players with Epilepsy problems.

notes.title: Update v1.12
notes.content:
A small update that adds the Swedish language.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Added Swedish language. Thank you, Simon Tessem (Gnydsmelt).

-Fixed issue with flush sound for toilets not being affected by the sound effects volume setting.

notes.title: Update v1.11
notes.content:
A small update that adds the Norwegian language and updates the Polish language.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Added Norwegian language. Thank you, Oddgeir Berge (TopDog).

-Updated Polish language, Thank you, Marcin Świszcz (Drenz).

notes.title: Update v1.10 - Quick update
notes.content:
A quick update to add Cultists back into the extra game modes in response to player feedback.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Cultist will now appear again in extra game modes.

-Added a toggle on the Extras screen to disable Cultists from appearing in extra game modes.

notes.title: Update v1.09
notes.content:
Small update that removes Cultists from the extra game modes in response to player feedback.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Due to player complaints the Cultist has been removed from the extra game modes. In progress Randomizer games will have different enemies when loaded.

-Fixed issue with the Cultist Shotgunner being able to instantly shoot after moving.

-The apartment sequence is now skipped and the player starts in the manor coffin when starting the Randomizer mode. 

-Hints are now disabled in Randomizer mode.

-Removed test code that forced the Cultist to shoot when pressing the L key.

notes.title: Update v1.08
notes.content:
Small update with a few quality of life changes.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-It is now possible to access the inventory and switch weapons while grabbed.

-Enemies in a sleeping or idle state now do not enable stamina consumption for the player.

-Replaced the "Unlock FPS" option with "Max Frame Rate" slider that allows manually setting the max frame rate.

-Fixed issue with reload prompt not displaying the correct input key.

notes.title: Update v1.07 - Small Update
notes.content:
Updated German translation and balance change for the Goatman Skirmisher.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Updated German translation. Thank you, S0LAR.

-Goatman spear throw animation now has a longer delay before throwing.

-Slightly reduced travel speed of Goatman spear.

notes.title: Update v1.06 - New languages
notes.content:
Small update that adds new languages.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Added Hungarian translation. Thank you, Boda Gábor (DEADEND GAMES).

-Added Czech translation. Thank you, Hipnog.

-Added Turkish translation. Thank you, Deniz Şen (PsyWarVeteran).

-Added German translation. Thank you, Kevin Winkler (Nuit Alecxander).

-Added option to "Unlock FPS" in the options menu which removes the 60 FPS lock.

-Localized the text for the shooting gallery in the manor.

-Fixed issue with the start room on maps generated in Dungeon Escape mode not properly being enclosed by doors.

notes.title: Update v1.05 - Small update
notes.content:
Added Italian and Portugese languages + some balance changes.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Added Italian language. Thank you, Alessandro Del Casale (Gordon-Ale).

-Added Portuguese (Brazil) language. Thank you, Igor Moraes (PhOeNiX_H).

-Fixed issue with enemies being able to shoot projectiles through solid obstacles.

-There is now a 25% bonus to damage when hitting zombies in the head.

-Increased Knife attack speed by 15%

-Slightly reduced movement speed of Spider.

-Animation for Spider bite attack now has a short delay before lunging.

-Fixed issue with spiders not properly conforming to the ground angle on the stairs leading to the Giant Spider boss.

notes.title: Update v1.04 - Small update
notes.content:
A small update to implement some balance changes. Mainly to make stamina more forgiving.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-The player now has infinite stamina and sprint while in an area with no enemies.

-Slightly reduced stamina cost for sprinting.

-Slightly increased stamina recovery speed.

-Reduced difficulty of summons for the Dungeon Lord boss in Dungeon Escape mode.

-Slightly increased the amount of items that spawn on floor 9 of Dungeon Escape mode.

-Increased chances of getting other types of ammo besides pistol ammo as the floor level increases in Dungeon Escape mode.

notes.title: Update v1.03 - New languages
notes.content:
Update that adds French, Spanish, Polish, Russian, and Chinese languages to the game.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Added French language. Thank you, Cédric Gauché (CdriX).

-Added Spanish language. Thank you, Ivan Rios (Falco).

-Added Polish language. Thank you, Błażej Roszkowski.

-Added Russian language. Thank you, Artyom Shilko (aCupOfPee).

-Added Chinese language. Thank you, Lai Fan Ho.

-It is now possible to use the Clock Key on the Grandfather Clock while in examine mode.

-Music now plays in Horde Mode during an active wave.

-Slightly increased the amount of items that spawn on floor 9 of Dungeon Escape mode.

-Increased reward for clearing a floor in Dungeon Escape mode from 200 to 400.

-Reduced throwing range of Goatman Skirmisher.

notes.title: Update v1.02 - Small Update
notes.content:
Small update to fix a game breaking bug and to apply some balance changes to the Cultists to make them less annoying to fight.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Fixed issue with mixing station puzzle where a chemical can be placed into an already filled beaker causing the game to soft-lock.

-Cultists now have a short delay before shooting in order to give the player time to react.

-Reduced travel speed of Pistol Cultist bullets from 90 to 60.

-Reduced travel speed of Shotgun Cultist bullets from 90 to 60.

-Reduced chance for Cultist to spawn in Dungeon Escape mode.

-Reduced health of Dungeon Lord boss in Dungeon Escape mode from 4000 to 2500.

-Rocket Launcher damage increased from 200 to 250.

-Options settings are now saved when closing the Options Menu. Previously, settings were only saved when quitting the game from the main menu.

notes.title: Update v1.01 - Balancing
notes.content:
Mainly balance adjustments to make gun handling easier and stamina less punishing.

Adjustments have also been made to the Randomizer mode which will cause Randomizer games in progress to have different enemies and items when loaded.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]

-Stamina is now replenished when transitioning between areas.

-Reduced delay for stamina regeneration from 2 seconds to 1.5 seconds.

-Reduced Pistol accuracy spread by 25%.

-Reduced Magnum accuracy spread by 20%.

-Reduced Submachine Gun accuracy spread by 25%.

-Increased Knife damage from 4 to 6.

-Slightly reduced accuracy of Pistol and Shotgun Cultist.

-Executioner boss in Dungeon Escape mode now rewards 100 credits when killed.

-Demon Lord boss in Dungeon Escape mode now rewards 200 credits when killed.

-Increased spawn chance of Shotgun Ammo in Randomizer mode.

-Increased spawn chance of Health Drink in Randomizer mode.

-Increased spawn chance of Dynamite in Randomizer mode.

-Reduced spawn chance of Cultist in Randomizer mode.

-Disabled Shotgun Cultist from spawning in Randomizer mode (they were making it overly difficult).

-Fixed issue when pressing the inventory key after death causing the inventory screen to be open after loading a game.

notes.title: Nightmare of Decay is now available!
notes.content:
Nightmare of Decay has been released and is now available for purchase on Steam.
Please enjoy!

notes.title: Demo update v0.83
notes.content:
I was a little too hasty in reducing ammo availability in the last update. I've reverted the ammo amounts back to what they were in 0.81. 

This should be the last update to the demo before the full release unless there are any serious bugs that need to be fixed.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

-Increased ammo amount when picking up Shotgun Ammo to 3 (from 2).

-Removed a shotgun and pistol ammo pickup from the Servant Dining Room (Room with the shotgun).

-Removed dialogue after waking up from the coffin (To make the sequence when first arriving at the manor more atmospheric and less text heavy). 

-Added an indicator for the impaled body in the Kitchen Pantry onto the minimap.

notes.title: Demo update v0.82
notes.content:
Small update for the demo to add in hotkeys for equippable items and a small adjusted to ammo balance (got a few complaints of the game being a little too easy after the last update). Keep in mind that balancing is still a work in progress.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

-Equippable items can now be assigned to number hotkeys.

-Number keys now cannot be used when rebinding in the controls option menu.

-Reduced Ammo amount when picking up shotgun ammo to 2 (Was 3).

-Added shotgun and pistol ammo pickups to Servant Dining room (room with the shotgun).

-Added hidden shotgun ammo pickup to courtyard (area with the dogs).

-Some fixes to dialogue.

notes.title: Demo update v0.81
notes.content:
Small update for the demo. Mainly to address issue with ammo being too scarce.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

-Ammo amount when picking up Pistol Ammo increased to 8 (from 5).

-Ammo amount when picking up Shotgun Ammo increased to 3 (from 2).

-Added Shotgun Ammo and a Health Drink to the chest in the reception room.

-Fixed various mistakes in the dialogue.
